claims.text: Hedy AI assists users in navigating professional conversations with confidence

quote.text: Your AI-powered assistant for navigating professional conversations with confidence

claims.text: iPhone users need iPhone 12 or newer to use the app

quote.text: For iPhone users, the app requires an iPhone 12 or newer.

claims.text: Android users need Android 12 or newer to use the app

quote.text: For Android users, the app requires Android 12 or newer

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: Hedy AI is available on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and web

quote.text: Hedy AI is available on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and web platforms.

claims.text: Users can import audio and video files by sharing from another app or within Hedy

quote.text: You can import audio and video files into Hedy by sharing the file from another app to Hedy or by importing within the Hedy app.

claims.text: Specific audio and video formats are supported for import

quote.text: Supported formats include MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC, WMA for audio, and MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WEBM, 3GP, WMV for video.

Yes, Hedy AI supports over 30 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Mandarin), Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Swedish, Vietnamese, Turkish, Malay, Indonesian, Norwegian, Ukrainian, and Russian.

claims.text: Hedy can connect to AI assistants via MCP using server URL and OAuth

quote.text: To connect Hedy with AI assistants using MCP, add the Hedy MCP server URL (https://api.hedy.bot/mcp) in your AI client's MCP server settings and authorize access through the OAuth flow.

claims.text: Hedy API provides access to meeting data, transcripts, summaries and insights

quote.text: The Hedy API provides programmatic access to your meeting data, transcripts, summaries, and AI-generated insights.

claims.text: Hedy has a native macOS app for desktop workflows

quote.text: Yes, Hedy has a native macOS app that delivers the full Hedy experience optimized for desktop workflows.

claims.text: Hedy integrates with Zapier to automate workflows

quote.text: Yes, Hedy integrates with Zapier, allowing you to connect with various tools to automate workflows such as sending session summaries to note-taking apps or logging highlights to knowledge management systems.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime means the lifetime of the product, not the buyer, which limits how long a lifetime deal can last.

quote.text: "Lifetime" refers to the lifetime of the product, not the lifetime of the purchaser

finePrint.summary: A lifetime license only guarantees the features that existed at purchase time.

quote.text: A Lifetime License grants perpetual access to the features available at the time of purchase.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime is sold as a one-time $299 payment that includes all future updates.

quote.text: Lifetime is a single payment of $299 that includes all future updates.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime licenses can still be subject to usage limits like transcription hours or storage.

quote.text: Usage limits (such as transcription hours or storage) may apply as specified at the time of purchase

finePrint.summary: The free tier is limited to 5 hours per month while paid tiers are marketed as unlimited.

quote.text: Start free with 5 hours every month. Upgrade anytime for unlimited access.

finePrint.summary: Free hours reset monthly and do not roll over, showing how Hedy enforces quotas.

quote.text: On the first day of each calendar month, in your device's time zone. Unused hours don't carry over.

finePrint.summary: Website purchases can be refunded only within 14 days of the original transaction.

quote.text: you may request a refund within 14 days of the original transaction date.

finePrint.summary: Google Play purchases must go through Google within 48 hours for the fastest refund.

quote.text: Within 48 hours of a charge, you can request a refund from Google directly, which is usually the fastest route.

finePrint.summary: Apple App Store refunds are handled entirely by Apple, not by Hedy.

quote.text: refunds are handled entirely by Apple in accordance with their refund policies.

finePrint.summary: Hedy can modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of the service at any time without notice.

quote.text: The Company reserves the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any aspect of the Services at any time, with or without notice.

finePrint.summary: Hedy can change the Terms themselves at any time with notice of material changes.

quote.text: The Company reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time.

finePrint.summary: Even lifetime features can be modified, replaced, or discontinued if equivalent functionality remains.

quote.text: The Company reserves the right to modify, replace, or discontinue specific features while maintaining substantially equivalent functionality

finePrint.summary: Hedy can terminate or suspend access at any time with or without cause on reasonable notice.

quote.text: The Company may terminate or suspend your access to the Services at any time, with or without cause, upon reasonable notice.

finePrint.summary: Accounts with inaccurate or violating registration information can be suspended or terminated.

quote.text: The Company reserves the right to suspend or terminate your account if any information provided proves to be inaccurate, false, or in violation of these Terms.

finePrint.summary: If Hedy shuts down, it only promises reasonable efforts to return data and provide a transition.

quote.text: In the event the Company ceases operations, reasonable efforts will be made to provide users with their data and a transition period

finePrint.summary: The comparable Pro plan is billed monthly or yearly versus the $299 lifetime one-time payment.

quote.text: Pro is billed monthly or yearly. Lifetime is a single payment of $299 that includes all future updates.

trials.claim: iPhone users need iPhone 12 or newer to use the app
trials.claimQuote: For iPhone users, the app requires an iPhone 12 or newer.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to check the iPhone 12 requirement against.

trials.claim: Android users need Android 12 or newer to use the app
trials.claimQuote: For Android users, the app requires Android 12 or newer
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to check the Android 12 requirement against.

trials.claim: Hedy AI assists users in navigating professional conversations with confidence
trials.claimQuote: Your AI-powered assistant for navigating professional conversations with confidence
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes Hedy as a conversation coach for confidence in meetings and similar settings, and a buyer says its real-time AI assistance during meetings works very well. The generic AI-error disclaimer and one negative review do not directly contradict that assistance claim.

exhibits.quote: AI-GENERATED CONTENT MAY CONTAIN ERRORS, INACCURACIES, OR OMISSIONS, AND SHOULD NOT BE RELIED UPON AS THE SOLE BASIS FOR IMPORTANT DECISIONS.
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own warranty disclaimer warns AI output may be erroneous and should not be relied on, undermining confidence claim.

exhibits.quote: It can only generate transcription, but not a detailed summary or note.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the assistant failed to provide summaries or real-time help, contradicting navigation with confidence.

exhibits.quote: Hedy is an AI-powered conversation coach that helps you speak with clarity, confidence, and impact in every meeting, interview, class, or pitch.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes Hedy as an AI-powered coach that helps users speak with confidence in professional settings like meetings.

exhibits.quote: The transcription is accurate, the real-time AI assistance during meetings works very well, and the post-meeting summaries are clear and useful.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the real-time AI assistance works well during meetings.

trials.claim: Hedy AI is available on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and web
trials.claimQuote: Hedy AI is available on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and web platforms.
trials.reasoning: The vendor says Pro works on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows, the web, and Apple Watch, and a buyer confirms smooth use on Windows, iOS, and Android. Reviews noting recording is mobile-only limit a feature, but do not show the platforms are unavailable.

exhibits.quote: Only the Hedy mobile app works to record your meetings.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports recording only works on mobile, undermining claim of full availability across all five platforms.

exhibits.quote: The web app cannot record; the only purpose of the web app is to export the transcript, set up Zapier or ask the Hedy AI questions about the completed meeting.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports web app cannot record, showing web availability is severely limited.

exhibits.quote: Yes. Sign in with the same account and Pro works on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows, the web, and Apple Watch.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states the product works across iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and web.

exhibits.quote: I’ve been using Hedy on Windows, iOS, and Android, and everything has worked smoothly and reliably across all three platforms.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms successful use on Windows, iOS and Android platforms.

trials.claim: Users can import audio and video files by sharing from another app or within Hedy
trials.claimQuote: You can import audio and video files into Hedy by sharing the file from another app to Hedy or by importing within the Hedy app.
trials.reasoning: Import is listed as a Pro feature rather than a general ability, and a buyer says they would love to be able to upload a recording. This materially limits the claim that users can import audio and video as described.

exhibits.quote: Import and transcribe past recordings and YouTube videos
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists import as a Pro-only bullet, so not all users can import as generally claimed.

exhibits.quote: I would also love to upload a transcript or audio recording.
exhibits.argument: Buyer requests upload ability, indicating import was not available to them.
